summary: Reject unbounded TAR extension headers before recovery import allocation

delivery.outcome: Fix confirmed PLF004 portable recovery import memory exhaustion, validate through Willman, publish through protected OneDev and independent Validator.
nonGoals: No existing IDE/session actions, remote bundle transfer, deployment, dependency changes or protected CI changes.
Preserve unresolved Willmux271 protected publication criterion and its existing evidence.

architecture.decision: A TarInfo subclass validates raw headers before tarfile processes extension bodies. Accept only plain regular records emitted by the existing USTAR exporter; reject PAX/GNU extension, sparse/nonregular and over-budget raw headers. Existing payload digests, inventory and file-state restoration stay in the importer.
architecture.rollback: Protected revert of the material implementation; no persisted format migration.

validation.evidence: 512-byte PAX/GNU fixtures are rejected without extension-sized reads; unsupported member types and raw byte budgets fail before import writes.
Valid plaintext/encrypted exporter/importer roundtrip passes; corrupted and malicious archives remain rejected.
Standard source suite, required X11 and managed gates pass via Willman.

commands: protected exact-head OneDev and independent Validator
validation.evidence: Trusted approval and protected merge of frozen candidate; no direct merge.
